title: COREM: Cosine-Relation Momentum Reshaping with Stateful Writeback
abstract: arXiv:2609.22487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Matrix-valued optimizer states may contain relational structure that is not captured by treating their entries independently. We study whether relations within matrix-valued optimizer states can be exploited to improve optimization. To this end, we introduce a unit-relation-transform abstraction and instantiate it as COREM, a Cosine-Relation Momentum Reshaping method with stateful writeback. COREM partitions the momentum state into update units, computes cosine relations among them, and uses these relations to reshape the momentum before writing the transformed state back to the optimizer. This stateful mechanism allows the reshaped momentum to affect not only the current update but also future optimization dynamics. We evaluate COREM on CIFAR-10 with an MLP and on enwik8 with a Transformer. translated_title: COREM：基于状态回写的余弦关系动量重塑
translated_abstract: 矩阵值优化器状态中可能包含在独立处理各元素时无法捕捉的关系结构。我们研究了能否利用矩阵值优化器状态内部的关系来改进优化。为此，我们引入了一种单元-关系-变换抽象，并将其实例化为COREM——一种带有状态回写机制的余弦关系动量重塑方法。COREM将动量状态划分为更新单元，计算它们之间的余弦关系，并利用这些关系重塑动量，然后将变换后的状态写回优化器。这种有状态机制使得重塑后的动量不仅能影响当前更新，还能影响未来的优化动态。我们在CIFAR-10上使用MLP、在enwik8上使用Transformer对COREM进行了评估。与Muon相比，COREM在训练早期的步效率较低，但在训练中后期的改进更强，取得了更好的最终性能。
tldr: 提出COREM方法，通过将动量状态划分为更新单元并利用其间的余弦关系重塑动量，借助有状态回写机制影响未来优化动态，在训练中后期相比Muon取得更好的效果。
en_tdlr: COREM reshapes momentum by partitioning the optimizer's momentum state into update units and exploiting cosine relations among them, with a stateful writeback mechanism that shapes future optimization dynamics, outperforming Muon in the mid-to-late stages of training.
